name: fixed-apr-1-india
description: India-style fiscal year starting 1 April, named by start year ('FY 2024-25'); scheme 'ay' is the assessment year, offset 1, with an en dash in its template to exercise non-ASCII labels. Scheme 'short' uses {yy}-{yy_next} with century_pivot 2069, so its label for 2099 is '99-00', which parses back as 1999 (the pivot window is 1970-2069), and {yy_next} is checked against the resolved year. Weeks use contains_start: week 1 runs from the year's first day to the day before the next week start (7 days when the year starts on the week-start weekday), and day_of_week counts from the weekday, so a partial week can begin on a day_of_week other than 1.

source.citation: Independent implementation of the spec in conformance/generators/fiscal_oracle.py, written with Python datetime and no fiscalclock code
